description.zh: 类似手环弹射的平面足球场。按住球向后拉、松手弹射，球速恒定永不减速，撞到边缘就反弹。球门开在左右两侧并且每脚随机换位置，进球后回中重来，五脚定胜负！
description.en: A slingshot pitch like the band classic. Pull the ball back and release — it flies at a constant speed and never slows down, bouncing off every edge. The goals sit on the left and right walls and move every shot. Score, reset, five shots per round!

controls.zh: 按住球向后拉（反方向），松手弹射；球速恒定，撞边缘反弹；Esc / P 暂停
controls.en: Pull the ball backward and release to slingshot it; constant speed, bounces off edges; Esc / P to pause
